description: Migration equivalence (MOD-D29 item 1, .github/workflows/migration-equivalence.yml). Names are files in tests/db/vendors; which servers are 6.0 targets and which are 5.17 sources comes from tests/db/migrate/matrix.json (MOD-D25). matrix.mjs turns this into the job matrices: push as listed; nightly in place on every target, and copies that take every vendor once as a source and once as a target, each into another vendor.
